_what: What the server stores and why (§20.5, §20.11, §20.12): every column of every table, the store data type it is, how long it is kept and what an account's deletion does to it. server/src/privacy.mjs checks it against the live schema and writes the store declarations from it; server/test/privacy.test.mjs checks the deletions and retention it states.

user-id.about: the account id, the platform identity, the telemetry pseudonym

purchase-history.about: store purchases and gifts (products, prices, refunds), owned cosmetics and premium tracks

gameplay.about: islands, heists and their replays, ratings, seasons

interaction.about: sessions and what was done in them

crash.about: whether a session ended in a crash

accounts.about: One row a player: who they are to the platform, their settings, and the markers of a ban or a deletion.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

id.holds: a random id the server gives the account

platform_identity.holds: the Game Center player id, or the Google account id

league.holds: nothing: an unused column, always its default

equipped.holds: the cosmetics the player wears, shown to raiders

pass_expires_at.holds: nothing: an unused column, always empty

keeper_level.holds: the Keeper level (§14.2), which matchmaking compares and the Keeper gates read

keeper_xp.holds: the experience toward the next Keeper level (§14.2)

created_at.holds: when the account was made, for the new player's shield

age_band.holds: the age band the device's age check answered (13-15 until it has)

moderator.holds: a staff role, set by the operator

analyst.holds: a staff role, set by the operator

banned_at.holds: when a moderator banned the account; the ban itself is kept in bans

banned_reason.holds: the removal reason the ban was made for

deleted_at.holds: when the account was deleted: the deletion log §20.12 keeps

time_zone.holds: the device's IANA time zone, for reminder times and the night (G34)

reminder_at.holds: the daily reminder time the player chose

night_quiet.holds: an adult's choice to open the night to notifications

seeded.holds: marks the game's own seeded islands' account

islands.about: Each player's current island in each realm.

snapshots.about: Every island ever published, by the hash of its bytes; never edited (§24.8). The bytes are in the public store, fetched by hash.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

snapshots.deletion_note: the row stays, as nobody's; an under-13 player's islands' bytes are deleted from the store

rules.holds: the rules version it was checked under

target_lists.about: The current target list of each difficulty band. The lists themselves are public objects naming each candidate island's owner, served with a cache life of one rebuild (an hour); a band keeps its current list and, for one rebuild after it is superseded, the one before, and then deletes it (G38).
target_lists.deletion_note: lists are made again at once without the player, and the one before is deleted

list.holds: the list object's hash; the list names players' account ids

previous.holds: the list before, still served for a moment

leases.about: Each heist a raider was allowed: target, seed, clock (§24.12).

keep.after: expiring unplayed; a played lease is a record kept for good (F43)

leases.deletion_note: an under-13 player's open leases are deleted

heists.about: Each submitted heist: the replay's hash, the verdict, what it paid (§24.8). The replay's bytes are kept 90 days in the private store.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

heists.deletion_note: an under-13 player's replays are deleted at once

review.holds: a replay that did not re-simulate, for review

ledger.about: Every movement of Starlight and Essence, the game's earned resources, append-only (§24.12); nothing in it is bought (F41).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

ratings.about: §12.22's Glicko-2 ratings: a raider's skill, an island's difficulty.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

ratings.deletion_note: severed on a deletion; deleted for an under-13 player

key.holds: the account, or the account and realm

defence_shares.about: Each season's defence reward share and the measure that set it: one figure for everyone.

keep.why: not about a person

workshop_items.about: Published Workshop islands, never edited or deleted (§18.6); on deletion they stay listed with no creator shown, or are withdrawn if the player asks (F43).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

workshop_items.deletion_note: listed with no creator shown, or withdrawn if the player asked; an under-13 player's islands are withdrawn and their bytes deleted

name_adjective.holds: a word from the game's list, not free text

name_noun.holds: a word from the game's list, not free text

workshop_plays.about: Each play of a Workshop island.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

workshop_plays.deletion_note: severed on a deletion; deleted for an under-13 player

workshop_completions.about: Each player's first clear of a Workshop island (§18.7).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

workshop_completions.deletion_note: severed on a deletion; deleted for an under-13 player

workshop_ratings.about: Each player's rating of a Workshop island (§18.6).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

workshop_ratings.deletion_note: severed on a deletion; deleted for an under-13 player

workshop_remixes.about: Each take of a Workshop island into a builder.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

workshop_remixes.deletion_note: severed on a deletion; deleted for an under-13 player

workshop_reports.about: Reports of Workshop islands, for a moderator (§20.4).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

workshop_reports.deletion_note: an under-13 player's reports stand as nobody's

reason.holds: a reason from the game's list, not free text

keep.why: not about a person

standings.about: A player's season: their starting Renown and track price.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

season_results.about: A closed season's result for each player (§18.1).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted
F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted
F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

constellation_results.about: A closed season's constellation league: groups, not people.

keep.why: not about a person

track_claims.about: Each season-track tier a player claimed.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

premium_tracks.about: Each season's premium track a player bought, as a store product or a friend's gift (F41); a refund takes it back (G32).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

constellations.about: Constellations: an id and a name from the game's word lists.

keep.why: not about a person

constellation_members.about: Who is, and was, in which constellation (§17.1).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

constellation_members.deletion_note: the player leaves; the row stays with left_at set

crews.about: Crews: an id and a join code.

keep.why: not about a person

crew_members.about: Who is, and was, in which crew (§17.7).

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

crew_members.deletion_note: the player leaves; the row stays with left_at set

challenges.about: Challenge links to a player's island (§17.6).

purchase_intents.about: Purchases asked for, held under a minor's monthly cap until the receipt comes (§20.2).

keep.after: lapsing unredeemed; a redeemed one is a record kept for good (F43)

recipient.holds: a gift's friend (F41); null for the buyer's own

purchases.about: Store receipts granted, append-only: a record of money taken, which tax law keeps.

keep.why: F43: kept for good, keyed by an id that leads to no one once the account is deleted

recipient.holds: a gift's friend (F41); null for the buyer's own

refunds.about: Refunds and revocations the stores reported, and refunds they reversed, one row an event (G32): the store and its transaction id, which, and when.

keep.why: a refund is a record of money, as a purchase is (22.1)

kind.holds: a refund, or a refund reversed

data.holds: the heists raided, or the reminder's day

attempts.holds: how often the push service could not take it

bans.about: Banned platform identities, apart from any account: §20.12's minimum kept to enforce a ban.
bans.deletion_note: kept: the ban outlives the account

banned_at.holds: the day of the ban, no finer

erasures.about: Files an under-13 deletion still has to delete, and the target lists it remakes, until done: hashes, no player.

event_batches.about: First-party telemetry (§24.3), batched, under a pseudonym: an HMAC of the account under the server's key.

events.holds: sign-ins, sessions (start and end) and their length, a crash flag, heists, laws woven, forms made, the worth rating, the survey and its chore answer, purchases

first_seen.about: Each pseudonym's first day, so a cohort outlives its raw events.

cohorts.about: Counts of each day's new players returning on day 1, 7, 30 and 60 (G29): no player in them.

keep.why: not about a person

event_days.about: Counts of each day's events by kind: no player in them.

keep.why: not about a person

bundles.about: the public object store: island bundles and target lists, fetched by hash
bundles.keep: islands for good (snapshots); target lists the current one a band, and the one before for an hour after it is superseded (G38)
bundles.deletion: an under-13 player's island bytes are deleted, and the lists made again without them

replays.about: the private replay store, fetched only by a heist's two players
replays.deletion: an under-13 player's replays are deleted at once

deletions.about: the deletion journal, in object storage: an account id, a reason, a time and the player's withdraw choice an object, outside the database so a restore cannot undo a deletion; a start makes again the last 31 days of it (F50)
deletions.deletion: a deletion is added, never removed

secret.about: the server's own key for tokens and pseudonyms

flows.carries: a session token naming the account; the bodies of each route
flows.to: the server, over HTTPS: the platform's edge terminates TLS and every answer carries Strict-Transport-Security

flows.carries: nothing of the player's: the server fetches Apple's public key by the URL the proof names
nothing of the player's: the server fetches the keys Google signs ID tokens with, from one fixed URL
the purchase's product and token, which Google issued, to look it up and acknowledge it, or consume it if it is a gift
flows.to: Google's Play Developer API, as the app's own service account

flows.carries: nothing of the player's: the app's package and a time window; Google answers with the purchase tokens it voided
flows.to: Google's Play Developer API, as the app's own service account

flows.carries: the push token and a message: localisation keys to show, how many raids and the latest one's id, or the reminder's day; it expires when the player's night begins
flows.to: Firebase Cloud Messaging, as the operator's service provider, which passes iPhone messages on to Apple's push service

flows.carries: a route and an error; never a path's ids or a body

answers.accountCreation: Sign-in with the platform's own identity (Game Center, Sign in with Google)
answers.deletionUrl: /account/delete on the game's server, signed in with Google (G39)
